sql: WITH hours AS (SELECT COALESCE(r.location_id, 0) AS location_id, t AS hour_myt, CAST(r.hourly.precipitation[i] AS DOUBLE) AS rain_mm FROM veda_wx.om_rain_jun2024 r LATERAL VIEW posexplode(r.hourly.time) h AS i, t) SELECT p.location_id, p.point_key, p.station_key, p.name, h.hour_myt, h.rain_mm FROM hours h JOIN veda_pg.rain_points p ON p.location_id = h.location_id WHERE h.hour_myt > '2024-06-12T10:00' AND h.hour_myt <= '2024-06-15T10:00'
